g.text: Two complete use cases; shared entity and ports

g.data-qualified-name: Order view and shared display state
g.text: Order view and shared display state
+commitTrade(order: Order, expected: OrderAccountSnapshot, updated: OrderAccountSnapshot): boolean
Compare expected state and commit cash + target quantity
+ appended history indivisibly, under account-wide coordination.
All stock symbols share cash. Preserve other holdings/history.
false only means account missing/changed; no writes.
Technical failures need separate handling, never false success.
The local checkout lacks the team User DAO implementation.
No fake team class or DAO field is added to the scaffold.
Future integration must stage a copy / atomic aggregate replacement.
Do not partially mutate a live User returned by findById.
Ordinary setters and save(User) do not prove atomicity.
App wiring supplies session::getUserID as currentUserId.
App wiring supplies portfolioController::viewPortfolio as refreshPortfolio.
Callbacks are the declared fields; team classes are not View fields.
Target: subscribe once, render changes, refresh once per new FILLED ID.
A display/refresh failure cannot reject an already committed trade.
Reuse the team's shared adapter (Order + Portfolio).
Single-currency target: no cashCurrency field / no FX.
Team references do not claim completed local Java implementations.
Business data only: no presentation message.
FILLED: ID and positive total present.
Rejected: status is not FILLED; ID and total are null.
Presenters own wording and amount formatting.
Direction is not a request field.
BuyOrderInteractor fixes BUY; SellOrderInteractor fixes SELL.
